claim.claim-text: 1. An apparatus to control ion energy, the apparatus comprising:
2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the power supply is coupled to the second node and the third node; and optionally wherein the third node is a ground terminal.
3. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the first voltage is a peak voltage.

4. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the apparatus comprises a controller to open the second switch before the first switch is closed and open the first switch before the second switch is closed to produce a waveform at the substrate support.

5. The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the controller is configured to control the first switch and the second switch so that the first switch and the second switch are open a majority of a time the waveform is produced at the substrate support; and optionally wherein the negative voltage is effectuated at the surface of the substrate while the first switch and the second switch are open.
6. A method for controlling ion energy, the method comprising:

switching a first voltage to a substrate support to produce a peak of a waveform and then disconnecting the first voltage from the substrate support, the substrate support supporting a substrate; and switching, after the first voltage is disconnected from the substrate support, a second voltage to the substrate support to produce a negative voltage at a surface of a substrate that attracts ions toward a surface of a substrate positioned on the substrate support.
7. The method of claim 8, wherein coupling the first voltage to the substrate support includes coupling the first voltage to the substrate support through an inductive element; or optionally

wherein coupling the second voltage to the substrate support includes coupling the second voltage to the substrate support through an inductive element; or optionally wherein coupling the second voltage to the substrate support includes coupling ground to the substrate support.

8. The method of claim 6 comprising switching, after the first voltage is disconnected from the substrate support, a second voltage to the substrate support, and then removing the second voltage from the substrate support to produce the negative voltage at the surface of the substrate that attracts ions toward the surface of the substrate.
9. The method of claim 6, wherein the first voltage and the second voltage are disconnected from the substrate support during a majority of the waveform; or optionally
10. An apparatus to produce a waveform, the apparatus comprising:
11. The apparatus of claim 10, wherein the switching circuitry is coupled to a ground terminal so the DC voltage and ground are alternately switched to the first node.

12. The apparatus of claim 10 comprising: a controller configured to receive a setpoint corresponding to the ion energy at a surface of the substrate and set the power supply to provide the DC voltage with a voltage magnitude corresponding to the ion energy.
13. The apparatus of claim 12, wherein the controller controls the power supply and the switching circuitry.
14. The apparatus of claim 12, wherein switching circuitry is controlled by a second controller that is separate from the controller.

15. The apparatus of claim 13, wherein the controller has an input to receive a setting indicative of the ion energy and the controller is configured to adjust the power supply so the power supply applies the DC voltage with a magnitude that achieves an energy of the ions.
